description: The file defines the final class InflateStream, which implements the StreamInterface from the PSR-7 standard. Its purpose is to decorate a given stream with PHP's zlib.inflate filter to support deflated (zlib or gzip) content, primarily used in HTTP response handling. The class uses a trait (StreamDecoratorTrait) for common stream functionalities and manages resources for inflating compressed content.

classes.name: InflateStream
classes.description: A stream decorator class that inflates compressed HTTP content using PHP's zlib.inflate filter.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that wraps the provided StreamInterface with a zlib.inflate filter to support decompression of zlib or gzip encoded streams.
